plan: 2 Samuel 6:12a; 1 Chronicles 15:1-28; 2 Samuel 6:12b-15, 16; 1 Chronicles 15:29; 2 Samuel 6:17-19a; 1 Chronicles 16:1-6, 7-36, 37-42, 43; 2 Samuel 6:19b-23

readings.title: The Ark on a New Cart
readings.text: [2 Samuel 6:1] Now Daviḏ again gathered <dn>את</dn> all the chosen men of Yisra’ěl, thirty thousand. [2] And Daviḏ rose up and went with all the people who were with him from Ba‛alě Yehuḏah, to bring up from there <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn>, that is called by the Name, the Name <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of Hosts, who dwells between the keruḇim. [3] And they placed <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn> on a new wagon, and brought it from the house of Aḇinaḏaḇ, which was on the hill. And Uzzah and Aḥyo, sons of Aḇinaḏaḇ, were leading <dn>את</dn> the new wagon. [4] And they brought it from the house of Aḇinaḏaḇ, which was on the hill, with the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn>. And Aḥyo was walking before the ark. [5] And Daviḏ and all the house of Yisra’ěl were dancing before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, with all instruments of fir wood, and with lyres, and with harps, and with tambourines, and with sistrums, and with cymbals.

readings.title: Uzzah and the Ark
readings.text: [2 Samuel 6:6] And when they came to the threshing-floor of Naḵon, Uzzah reached out toward the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn> and took hold of it, for the oxen stumbled. [7] And the wrath of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> burned against Uzzah, and <dn>Elohim</dn> struck him there for the fault. And he died there by the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn>. [8] And Daviḏ was displeased because <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had broken out against Uzzah. And he called <dn>את</dn> the name of the place Perets Uzzah, until this day. [9] And Daviḏ was afraid of <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> on that day, and said, “How shall the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> come to me?” [10] And Daviḏ would not move <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with him into the City of Daviḏ, but Daviḏ turned it aside to the house of Oḇěḏ-Eḏom the Gittite. [11] And the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> remained in the house of Oḇěḏ-Eḏom the Gittite three new moons, and <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> blessed <dn>את</dn> Oḇěḏ-Eḏom and <dn>את</dn> all his house.

readings.title: Preparing a Place for the Ark
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 15:1] And he built houses for himself in the City of Daviḏ. And he prepared a place for the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn>, and pitched a tent for it. [2] Then Daviḏ said, “No one is to lift <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn> but the Lěvites, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has chosen them to lift <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn> and to serve <dn>Him</dn> forever.” [3] And Daviḏ assembled <dn>את</dn> all Yisra’ěl at Yerushalayim, to bring up <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to its place, which he had prepared for it. [4] And Daviḏ gathered <dn>את</dn> the children of Aharon and <dn>את</dn> the Lěvites; [5] of the sons of Qehath: Uri’ěl the chief, and one hundred and twenty of his brothers; [6] of the sons of Merari: Asayah the chief, and two hundred and twenty of his brothers; [7] of the sons of Gěreshom: Yo’ěl the chief, and one hundred and thirty of his brothers; [8] of the sons of Elitsaphan: Shemayah the chief, and two hundred of his brothers; [9] of the sons of Ḥeḇron: Eli’ěl the chief, and eighty of his brothers; [10] of the sons of Uzzi’ěl: Amminaḏaḇ the chief, and one hundred and twelve of his brothers. [11] And Daviḏ called for Tsaḏoq and Eḇyathar the priests, and for the Lěvites, for Uri’ěl, Asayah, and Yo’ěl, Shemayah, and Eli’ěl, and Amminaḏaḇ, [12] and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Lěvites. Set yourselves apart, you and your brothers, then you shall bring up <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl to the place I have prepared for it. [13] “Because you did not do it the first time, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn> broke out against us, because we did not ask <dn>Him</dn> about the right-ruling.” [14] So the priests and the Lěvites set themselves apart, to bring up <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl. [15] And the children of the Lěvites bore <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn> on their shoulders, by its poles, as Mosheh had commanded according to the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Singers and Musicians Appointed
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 15:16] And Daviḏ spoke to the leaders of the Lěvites to appoint <dn>את</dn> their brothers the singers with instruments of song, harps, and lyres, and cymbals, to lift up the voice with joy. [17] And the Lěvites appointed <dn>את</dn> Hěman son of Yo’ěl, and of his brothers, Asaph son of Bereḵyahu; and of their brothers, the sons of Merari, Ěythan son of Qushayahu; [18] and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zeḵaryahu, Běn, and Ya‛azi’ěl, and Shemiramoth, and Yeḥi’ěl, and Unni, Eliyaḇ, and Benayahu, and Ma‛asěyahu, and Mattithyahu, and Eliphelěhu, and Miqněyahu, and Oḇěḏ-Eḏom, and Ye‛i’ěl, the gatekeepers; [19] and the singers Hěman, Asaph, and Ěythan, were to sound the cymbals of bronze; [20] and Zeḵaryah, and Azi’ěl, and Shemiramoth, and Yeḥi’ěl, and Unni, and Eliyaḇ, and Ma‛asěyahu, and Benayahu, with harps according to Alamoth; [21] and Mattithyahu, and Eliphelěhu, and Miqněyahu, and Oḇěḏ-Eḏom, and Ye‛i’ěl, and Azazyahu, to lead with lyres on the Sheminith; [22] and Kenanyahu, leader of the Lěvites in the song, instructed in the song because he was skilled; [23] and Bereḵyah and Elqanah were doorkeepers for the ark; [24] and Sheḇanyahu, and Yoshaphat, and Nethan’ěl, and Amasai, and Zeḵaryahu, and Benayahu, and Eli‛ezer, the priests, were to blow the trumpets before the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn>. And Oḇěḏ-Eḏom and Yeḥiyah, were doorkeepers for the ark.

readings.title: Bringing Up the Ark with Joy
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 15:25] And it was Daviḏ and the elders of Yisra’ěl, and the commanders over thousands, who went to bring up <dn>את</dn> the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> from the house of Oḇěḏ-Eḏom with joy. [26] And it came to be, when <dn>Elohim</dn> helped the Lěvites who bore the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, that they slaughtered seven bulls and seven rams. [27] And Daviḏ was dressed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Lěvites who bore <dn>את</dn> the ark, the singers, and Kenanyah the leader of the service with the singers. And Daviḏ wore a linen shoulder garment. [28] So all Yisra’ěl brought up <dn>את</dn> the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with shouting and with a voice of a shophar, with trumpets and with cymbals, sounding with harps and lyres.

readings.title: The Ark Brought to the City of David
readings.text: [2 Samuel 6:12] And it was reported to Sovereign Daviḏ, saying, “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has blessed <dn>את</dn> the house of Oḇěḏ-Eḏom and <dn>את</dn> all that he has, because of the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn>.” Daviḏ then went and brought up <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn> from the house of Oḇěḏ-Eḏom to the City of Daviḏ with rejoicing. [13] And it came to be, when those bearing the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had gone six steps, that he slaughtered bulls and fatted sheep. [14] And Daviḏ danced before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with all his might. And Daviḏ was wearing a linen shoulder garment. [15] Thus Daviḏ and all the house of Yisra’ěl brought up <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with shouting and with a voice of a shophar. [16] And it came to be, when the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came into the City of Daviḏ, that Miḵal, daughter of Sha’ul, looked through a window and saw <dn>את</dn> Sovereign Daviḏ leaping and dancing before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and she despised him in her heart. [17] So they brought the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in, and set <dn>את</dn> it in its place in the midst of the Tent that Daviḏ had pitched for it. And Daviḏ brought ascending offerings before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and peace offerings. [18] And when Daviḏ had finished bringing ascending offerings and peace offerings, he blessed <dn>את</dn> the people in the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts. [19] And he apportioned to all the people, to all the crowd of Yisra’ěl, from man even to women, to each one a loaf of bread, and a measure, and a cake of raisins. And all the people left, each one to his house.

readings.title: Michal Despises David
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 15:29] And it came to be, as the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to the City of Daviḏ, that Miḵal the daughter of Sha’ul, looking through a window, saw <dn>את</dn> Sovereign Daviḏ dancing and playing. And she despised him in her heart.

readings.title: David and Michal
readings.text: [2 Samuel 6:20] And Daviḏ returned to bless <dn>את</dn> his household, and Miḵal the daughter of Sha’ul came out to meet Daviḏ, and said, “How esteemed was the sovereign of Yisra’ěl today, uncovering himself today in the eyes of the female servants of his servants, as one of the foolish ones shamelessly uncovers himself!” [21] So Daviḏ said to Miḵal, “Before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, who chose me instead of your father and all his house, commanded <dn>את</dn> me to be ruler over the people of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, over Yisra’ěl, so I danced before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [22] “And I shall be even more slight than this, and shall be humble in my own eyes. But as for the female servants of whom you have spoken, by them I am esteemed.” [23] And Miḵal the daughter of Sha’ul had no children to the day of her death.
